name: distill-essence-engine
description: Distill the essence of any content into a prompt for imagery — still or moving (what one generation holds is declared by the format). Given content (novel, article, poem, transcript, memo, paper …) plus a natural-language spec of what to make and in what style, applies the transformation principles (understand → select → translate → keep consistent → compose → style → negative → stay faithful) to produce an English prompt for Stable Diffusion / Midjourney / Wan.
